questions.question: Write down the square numbers up to 12² and the cube numbers up to 6³.
Explain what √144 and ∛216 mean, using shapes.
questions.expected_answer: √144 is the side of a square with area 144: 12, because 12 × 12 = 144. ∛216 is the edge of a cube with volume 216: 6, because 6 × 6 × 6 = 216.

questions.question: Calculate √144 + ∛125 and explain why √(9 + 16) is not 3 + 4.
questions.expected_answer: 12 + 5 = 17. √(9 + 16) = √25 = 5; the sum must be found first, and 7² = 49, not 25.
